# Warehouse ERP Migration

Migrating **HEXA Purchase Assistant** from Flutter + FastAPI + PostgreSQL (`source-app/`) to React + TypeScript + Node/Express + SQL Server (`new-app/`).

## Quick start for Cursor Pro

1. Open this folder (`warehouse-migration/`) as the workspace root.
2. Read [docs/CURSOR_SETUP.md](docs/CURSOR_SETUP.md).
3. Follow [docs/00_MASTER_CHECKLIST.md](docs/00_MASTER_CHECKLIST.md).
4. Use prompts in `.cursor/prompts/` — one fresh Agent chat per module.

**Do not edit `source-app/`.** It is the read-only source of truth.
